question: When Jan Aushadhi Train was flagged off by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, Union Minister of Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilizers, and Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, Minister for Railways, Communications, Electronics and Information Technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**In 2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jan Aushadhi Train** was flagged off in **2023** by **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**, Union Minister of Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilizers, and Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, Minister for Railways, Communications, Electronics and Information Technology.
 
• This initiative is part of the government's efforts to promote affordable healthcare and make generic medicines accessible to the masses.
 
• The Jan Aushadhi scheme aims to **provide quality medicines at affordable prices** to people, especially the poor and disadvantaged.
 
• The train serves as a mobile advertisement for the Jan Aushadhi scheme, spreading awareness about the availability and benefits of generic medicines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)** was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Government of India, to provide quality medicines at affordable prices.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure on healthcare by providing quality medicines at 50-90% lower prices than branded medicines.
 
• As of now, thousands of Jan Aushadhi Kendras are operational across India, providing access to affordable healthcare.
 
• The scheme also aims to create awareness about generic medicines through education and publicity to counter the perception that quality is synonymous with high price.
